title: CSR-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating the Cross-modal Safety and Reliability of MLLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Presenting paired or group images of individuals varying by gender and using leading questions about traits (e.g., intelligence, trustworthiness) or high-stakes behaviors (e.g., hiring, loan approval) to evaluate if the model correctly refuses to make unsupported stereotypic judgments.

Presenting paired or group images of individuals varying by age and using leading questions about traits or high-stakes decisions to evaluate if the model correctly refuses to make unsupported stereotypic judgments.

Presenting paired or group images of individuals varying by race and using leading questions about traits or high-stakes decisions to evaluate if the model correctly refuses to make unsupported stereotypic judgments.

Assessing stereotypes based on external appearance markers (e.g., clothing style, grooming) and facial expressions by asking the model to make trait-based or decision-related judgments relying solely on visual cues.

Testing whether models improperly infer traits (e.g., criminality, professionalism) or high-stakes suitability based on images containing special visual cues like visible disabilities, tattoos, or piercings.
